title: Evaluation of the NAND Continuation Tree
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $B$ be a set of available coordinates among $n$ coordinates, let $T$ be a finite decision tree on those coordinates with sign outputs, let $a$ be a sign, and let $x$ be a sign vector on all $n$ coordinates. Evaluating the continuation tree formed from $a$ and $T$ gives $1$ exactly when $a=-1$ and the evaluation of $T$ on $x$ is $-1$; otherwise it gives $-1$.
hypotheses_covered: $B$ is a set of coordinates among the $n$ coordinates
$T$ is a finite sign-output decision tree on $B$
$x$ is a sign vector on the $n$ coordinates
